entries.reason: Facts, policy outcomes and rule latches persist as typed Protobuf records rather than hand-written Value JSON trees.
entries.schema: eve.emergence.proto.FactStoreSave and RuleEngineSave contain typed fact maps, policy results and rule latches.
entries.version: Both binary roots write version 2; version-1 JSON remains readable only at the compatibility import boundary.
entries.migration: restoreJson accepts previous version-1 fact and runtime documents, then publishes a fully validated candidate.
entries.unknown_fields: Binary restore rejects unknown Protobuf fields recursively; Protobuf JSON parsing is strict and dynamic payloads are validated.
entries.restore_atomicity: FactStore builds detached maps, and RuleEngine builds detached facts and latches before replacing authoritative state.

entries.reason: Known rule and condition definitions use typed Protobuf; only open-ended arguments use DynamicValue.
entries.schema: eve.emergence.proto.RuleCatalogueSave contains typed rule, condition, action and declaration records.
entries.version: Canonical binary catalogues write version 2; version-1 JSON is import-only.
entries.migration: replaceCatalogueJson accepts legacy version-1 documents and typed version-2 Protobuf JSON.
entries.unknown_fields: Binary import recursively rejects unknown Protobuf fields and invalid enum or variant fields.
entries.restore_atomicity: All records decode and validate before replaceCatalogue publishes the new catalogue.

entries.reason: Binary snapshot, restore and rule-catalogue import are canonical persistence faces; script JSON calls remain compatibility entry points.

trim.absent_profile: No L1-L4 trim claim is made for the persistence format change.

entries.thread_affinity: All capture and restore calls run on the owning simulation thread without callbacks during publication.
cost_notes: Snapshot and restore cost linear time in fact payload bytes and rule count.
